build_common_tools_justification: The build uses widely adopted Node.js, npm, TypeScript, and Next.js tooling: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/package.json.
build_floss_tools_justification: The project can be built using FLOSS tools: Node.js, npm, TypeScript, and Next.js. See https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/package.json.
build_justification: The source is reproducibly installable and buildable with npm ci and npm run build; instructions are in https://github.com/udid-tools/website#local-development.
contribution_justification: The pull-request contribution process is documented at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_requirements_justification: Acceptable contribution, coding, dependency, testing, privacy, commit, and pull-request requirements are documented at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
crypto_call_justification: Cryptography is delegated to Node.js node:crypto and the public @udid-tools/core library; the website does not implement cryptographic primitives itself.
crypto_floss_justification: All project cryptographic functionality is implemented through FLOSS Node.js/OpenSSL and @udid-tools/core components.
crypto_keylength_justification: Result tokens use 256-bit AES keys, HMAC secrets are required to be 256 bits, and production profile signing uses caller-provided modern certificates: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/src/lib/result-token.ts and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/src/lib/server-config.ts.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The website has no external user accounts and stores no passwords for inbound authentication.
crypto_pfs_justification: The application implements no key-agreement protocol. Transport key agreement and forward secrecy are provided by the managed HTTPS/TLS platform.
crypto_published_justification: The project uses publicly specified, expert-reviewed primitives and formats: AES-256-GCM, HMAC-SHA-256, CMS/PKCS#7, X.509, and TLS.
crypto_random_justification: All application-generated nonces and IVs use Node.js cryptographically secure randomBytes: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/src/lib/profile-challenge.ts and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/src/lib/result-token.ts.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Default mechanisms use AES-256-GCM, HMAC-SHA-256, SHA-256 signatures, and TLS and do not depend on SHA-1 or other algorithms with known serious weaknesses.
crypto_working_justification: Default mechanisms use AES-256-GCM, HMAC-SHA-256, SHA-256 signatures, and TLS; no broken cryptographic algorithm is required by default.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source, releases, dependencies, and production are delivered over HTTPS, and the exact deployed release artifact is checksum-verified and Sigstore-attested: https://github.com/udid-tools/website#release-integrity.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Release artifacts and checksums are retrieved over HTTPS and the artifact is verified with a Sigstore attestation before deployment: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml.
description: Open-source Safari-based UDID lookup for iPhone and iPad beta testing, ad hoc device registration, mobile QA, and iOS provisioning workflows.
description_good_justification: The project purpose and the problem it solves are described in the README: https://github.com/udid-tools/website#readme
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests provide searchable, addressable, publicly accessible discussions: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/issues and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/pulls.
documentation_basics_justification: The README documents the project, local setup, verification, release integrity, security reporting, and licensing: https://github.com/udid-tools/website#readme.
documentation_interface_justification: The project exposes no supported public programming interface. Its supported external interface is the user-facing website and guided UDID flow; Profile Service endpoints are internal implementation details.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Vitest and fast-check execute extensive runtime assertions during unit, route, negative, boundary, and property-based tests: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/tree/main/src/lib/__tests__.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: There are no unresolved medium-or-higher exploitable findings from the automated tests or property-based fuzzing; confirmed failures block CI and releases.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The project runs an automated test suite with more than 80% branch coverage and property-based fuzzing on changes and before release: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/fuzz.yml.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project is written in TypeScript and JavaScript and contains no project-produced code in a memory-unsafe language.
english_justification: The README, contribution guide, security policy, issue templates, source comments, and issue tracker accept and use English: https://github.com/udid-tools/website.
enhancement_responses_justification: The public project is newer than two months, so no enhancement requests fall within the criterion's 2–12 month evaluation window.
floss_license_justification: The project is released under the MIT license: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/LICENSE.
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open-source license: https://opensource.org/license/mit.
interact_justification: The live utility is available at https://www.udid.tools/. Feedback is accepted through https://github.com/udid-tools/website/issues, and contribution instructions are at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
know_common_errors_justification: The primary maintainer demonstrates knowledge of web and supply-chain risks including untrusted-input parsing, injection and XSS, secret leakage, request-size exhaustion, cryptographic misuse, dependency compromise, and sensitive-data exposure, with mitigations documented at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/SECURITY.md and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
know_secure_design_justification: The primary maintainer applies fail-safe defaults, least privilege, bounded allowlist validation, minimal attack surface, authenticated encryption, private reporting, and privacy-preserving telemetry. The design and residual risks are documented at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
license_location_justification: The license is in the standard top-level LICENSE file: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/LICENSE.
maintained_justification:
The project is actively maintained with current production releases, automated dependency maintenance, and maintainer-reviewed pull requests.
https://github.com/udid-tools/website/releases/latest
name: UDID Tools Website
no_leaked_credentials_justification: Credentials and production verification material are kept in GitHub environment secrets and are injected only during release; the repository contains templates but no valid private credentials.
release_notes_justification:
Each GitHub Release contains generated, human-readable release notes.
https://github.com/udid-tools/website/releases/latest
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has fixed a publicly known runtime vulnerability with an assigned CVE or similar identifier.
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a common distributed version-control system: https://github.com/udid-tools/website.
repo_interim_justification: The repository contains commits and pull requests between releases for collaborative review: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/commits/main and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/pulls.
repo_public_justification: The public Git repository is available at https://github.com/udid-tools/website.
repo_track_justification: Git records each change, author, and timestamp: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/commits/main.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues provides a permanent, publicly searchable archive of reports and responses: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/issues.
report_process_justification: Users can submit bugs through the public issue tracker and structured bug-report form: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml.
report_responses_justification: The public project is newer than two months, so no bug reports fall within the criterion's 2–12 month evaluation window.
report_tracker_justification: Individual bugs and enhancements are tracked in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/issues.
sites_https_justification: The website, repository, release, issue, and documentation URLs use HTTPS.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL uses the security-extended query suite for JavaScript and TypeScript vulnerabilities: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: There are no unresolved medium-or-higher exploitable CodeQL findings; confirmed findings must pass the required security checks before integration.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL security-extended analysis runs before releases through protected-main checks: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and pull request to main and on a weekly schedule: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs formatting, linting, strict type checking, coverage tests, and the production build on every push and pull request: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
test_invocation_justification: The standard npm test command invokes the full Vitest suite: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/package.json.
test_justification: The public Vitest suites are in the repository and npm run verify runs them with coverage: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/tree/main/src and https://github.com/udid-tools/website#local-development.
test_most_justification: The automated suite exceeds 80% branch coverage and covers request parsing, result tokens, challenges, observability, HTTP bounds, and application routes.
test_policy_justification: The contribution policy requires verification and requires negative and resource-bound tests for new untrusted-input paths: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_are_added_justification: Tests accompany the project's recent token, challenge, request-processing, observability, and fuzzing functionality: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/tree/main/src/lib/__tests__ and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/src/app/api/retrieve/route.test.ts.
tests_documented_added_justification: The contribution guide and pull-request template document verification and testing expectations: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md.
version_tags_justification: Every release is identified by a GitHub-verified signed annotated Git tag: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/tags.
version_unique_justification:
Every user-facing release has a unique Semantic Versioning identifier and an immutable release artifact.
https://github.com/udid-tools/website/releases/latest
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: There are no known unresolved critical project vulnerabilities. Private reporting and response targets are documented at https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unpatched medium-or-higher project vulnerabilities older than 60 days; CodeQL and dependency audits run continuously: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yml.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md directs reporters to GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting and explains what not to disclose publicly: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability-reporting process is published in SECURITY.md: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received during the repository's first six months.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any ESLint warning or TypeScript error, so warnings must be addressed before integration: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
warnings_justification: ESLint with zero allowed warnings and strict TypeScript checks run in the required verification gate: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/package.json.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript enables strict plus additional safety flags, and ESLint uses --max-warnings=0: https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/tsconfig.json and https://github.com/udid-tools/website/blob/main/package.json.
